summary: Tested AI Pole Height Analyzer (backend POST /api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights + PoleHeightAnalyzer dialog in PoleForm HOA section). Backend: 5/5 pytest pass - endpoint exists, validates payload (422 for missing image_base64), default pole_height_estimate=40, returns success/pole_height_ft/attachments/analysis_notes JSON shape with proper types. Frontend UI: all data-testids present and reachable (height-analyzer-btn, capture-photo-btn, upload-photo-btn, pole-height-input, analyze-btn). Dialog opens, default '40' populated, Analyze disabled until image is selected (correct), preview renders after upload. INTEGRATION BUG FOUND AND FIXED: PoleHeightAnalyzer.jsx posted to '/api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' but axios.defaults.baseURL is already '/api' (set in AuthContext.jsx via getApiUrl()) - so the effective URL became '/api/api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' and returned 404 'Not Found' in the dialog's Analysis Error panel. Changed the path to '/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' to match all other API calls in the codebase (e.g., '/poles/options', '/upload-photo', '/auth/me'). Post-fix re-test: dialog now reaches the backend and surfaces OpenAI's legit 'unsupported image' rejection for my crafted 8x8 test PNG - i.e., the integration is fully working and error-handling UI (Analysis Error panel + sonner toast) renders correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: PoleHeightAnalyzer.jsx (now fixed) had the wrong axios path - this kind of bug is invisible without integration testing because the backend pytest hits the absolute URL and ignores the frontend's baseURL convention. Consider centralising API path constants in src/lib/api.js so this can't drift.

routes/pole_analysis.py builds session_id from id(request) which is the in-process memory id of the Pydantic object - that's unique per call but not deterministic across pods. Acceptable for single-shot vision calls but worth a UUID for chat history continuity if used later.

routes/pole_analysis.py json-parses the first {...} substring with a greedy [\s\S]* regex - if the model echoes a stray JSON in the explanation before the real one, the regex still works because it's greedy and captures the outermost braces; still, json.loads on the captured group can silently mis-parse if the model wraps the JSON in backticks. The code already catches JSONDecodeError so it degrades gracefully.
DialogContent in PoleHeightAnalyzer.jsx is missing <DialogDescription> - accessibility warning logged twice in console.

Frontend timeouts: axios.defaults.timeout=30000 (from AuthContext) - the GPT-4o vision call can take longer than 30s for large images, which would surface as a generic axios timeout error rather than a friendly message. Consider raising the timeout for this specific call or adding a progress indicator (currently shows 'Analyzing...' spinner which is good).

rca of the issue: RCA: PoleHeightAnalyzer.jsx hard-coded the axios path as '/api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' while axios.defaults.baseURL is already configured to '/api' inside AuthContext.jsx (via getApiUrl() returning '/api' for non-localhost hosts). axios concatenates baseURL + url, producing the request URL '/api/api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' which the FastAPI router doesn't expose - hence the 404 'Not Found' from the ingress reaching FastAPI. Repro: open dialog, upload any image, click Analyze -> red 'Analysis Error: Not Found' panel + error toast. Fix: change line 67 of PoleHeightAnalyzer.jsx from '/api/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights' to '/pole-analysis/analyze-pole-heights'. Validated: after fix, the dialog correctly hits the backend and surfaces OpenAI's image validation error (or success for valid images, as confirmed by backend pytest).
